elements.body: FY27 revenue **{{(SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / 1000000 | $,.1f}}M** {{If(((SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / (SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] = "Actual" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 1 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 12)) - 1) >= 0, Concat("▲ ", Text(Round(((SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / (SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] = "Actual" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 1 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 12)) - 1) * 100, 1)), "%"), "")}}{{If(((SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / (SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] = "Actual" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 1 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 12)) - 1) < 0, Concat("▼ ", Text(Round(Abs((SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / (SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] = "Actual" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 1 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 12)) - 1) * 100, 1)), "%"), "")}} vs FY26 actual

Gross margin **{{(SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Cost of Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / (SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) | .1%}}** {{(SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Cost of Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / 1000000 | $,.1f}}M gross margin

EBITDA **{{(SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Cost of Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Operating Expenses" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / 1000000 | $,.1f}}M** {{(SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Cost of Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Operating Expenses" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / (SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) | .1%}} margin

Forecast months left **{{DateDiff("month", Max([Forecast Boundary/Start Month]), MakeDate(2027, 12, 1)) + 1}} of 12** {{DateFormat(Max([Forecast Boundary/Start Month]), "%b-%y")}} → {{DateFormat(MakeDate(2027, 12, 1), "%b-%y")}}

elements.body: ## Growth drivers Monthly growth rate per forecast line. Edit a rate and the forecast recalculates. Manual forecast lines are typed in by hand, as in the source workbook, rather than grown from a driver. Scenario: **{{[Scenario]}}** (switch it in the Forecast header; Downside and Upside move every growth rate by the source workbook's spread).

**Forecast impact** Recalculates as you edit. FY27 revenue **{{(SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / 1000000 | $,.1f}}M** FY27 EBITDA **{{(SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Cost of Revenue" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Forecast Facts/Amount], [Forecast Facts/Section] = "Operating Expenses" and [Forecast Facts/Period] != "Plan" and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / 1000000 | $,.1f}}M**

elements.body: ## Versions & approvals Snapshot freezes the headline numbers as a version; Submit for approval logs a request. Both are written by the buttons on the Forecast page (or by the forecast agent, after you approve), with who and when, newest first. Both logs start empty in a new workbook.
## Compare to a saved version {{If(Count([Frozen Versions/Version]) = 0, "No saved versions to compare yet", "Rebuilt from the saved inputs with actuals as they are now")}}

EBITDA **{{(SumIf([Compare Facts/Amount], [Compare Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Compare Facts/Which] = "Today" and [Compare Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Compare Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Compare Facts/Amount], [Compare Facts/Section] = "Cost of Revenue" and [Compare Facts/Which] = "Today" and [Compare Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Compare Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Compare Facts/Amount], [Compare Facts/Section] = "Operating Expenses" and [Compare Facts/Which] = "Today" and [Compare Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Compare Facts/Month Num] <= 24)) / 1000000 | $,.1f}}M** Version {{(If(Count([Version Pick/Version]) = 0, Null, SumIf([Compare Facts/Amount], [Compare Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Compare Facts/Which] = "Version" and [Compare Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Compare Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Compare Facts/Amount], [Compare Facts/Section] = "Cost of Revenue" and [Compare Facts/Which] = "Version" and [Compare Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Compare Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - SumIf([Compare Facts/Amount], [Compare Facts/Section] = "Operating Expenses" and [Compare Facts/Which] = "Version" and [Compare Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Compare Facts/Month Num] <= 24))) / 1000000 | $,.1f}}M Change since version {{(SumIf([Compare Facts/Amount], [Compare Facts/Section] = "Revenue" and [Compare Facts/Which] = "Today" and [Compare Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Compare Facts/Month Num] <= 24) - source.statement:
select * from (values
('North America Revenue', 1),
('EMEA Revenue', 2),
('APAC Revenue', 3),
('LATAM Revenue', 4),
('North America Cost of Revenue', 5),
('EMEA Cost of Revenue', 6),
('APAC Cost of Revenue', 7),
('LATAM Cost of Revenue', 8),
('North America Opex', 9),
('EMEA Opex', 10),
('APAC Opex', 11),
('LATAM Opex', 12)
) as t(LINE_ITEM, LINE_ORDER)

columns.formula: Coalesce([Last Actual], If([Kind] = "flat", [June Base], [June Base] * (1 + [Eff Rate]) ^ ([Base Key] - 24330)))

columns.formula: Switch([Forecast Spine/Line Item], "North America Revenue", Max([Version Pick/North America Revenue rate]), "EMEA Revenue", Max([Version Pick/EMEA Revenue rate]), "APAC Revenue", Max([Version Pick/APAC Revenue rate]), "LATAM Revenue", Max([Version Pick/LATAM Revenue rate]), "North America Cost of Revenue", Max([Version Pick/North America Cost of Revenue rate]), "EMEA Cost of Revenue", Max([Version Pick/EMEA Cost of Revenue rate]), "APAC Cost of Revenue", Max([Version Pick/APAC Cost of Revenue rate]), "LATAM Cost of Revenue", Max([Version Pick/LATAM Cost of Revenue rate]), "North America Opex", Max([Version Pick/North America Opex rate]), "EMEA Opex", Max([Version Pick/EMEA Opex rate]), [Forecast Spine/Default Rate]) + Switch(Max([Version Pick/Scenario]), "Downside", [Forecast Spine/Downside Spread], "Upside", [Forecast Spine/Upside Spread], 0)
columns.name: Eff Rate

columns.formula: If([Forecast Spine/Line Item] = "LATAM Opex" and [Forecast Spine/Month Num] = 19, Max([Version Pick/LATAM Opex Jul-27]), [Forecast Spine/Line Item] = "LATAM Opex" and [Forecast Spine/Month Num] = 20, Max([Version Pick/LATAM Opex Aug-27]), [Forecast Spine/Line Item] = "LATAM Opex" and [Forecast Spine/Month Num] = 21, Max([Version Pick/LATAM Opex Sep-27]), [Forecast Spine/Line Item] = "LATAM Opex" and [Forecast Spine/Month Num] = 22, Max([Version Pick/LATAM Opex Oct-27]), [Forecast Spine/Line Item] = "LATAM Opex" and [Forecast Spine/Month Num] = 23, Max([Version Pick/LATAM Opex Nov-27]), [Forecast Spine/Line Item] = "LATAM Opex" and [Forecast Spine/Month Num] = 24, Max([Version Pick/LATAM Opex Dec-27]), [Forecast Spine/Manual Value])
columns.name: Eff Manual

columns.formula: DatePart("year", [Forecast Spine/Month End]) * 12 + DatePart("month", [Forecast Spine/Month End])
columns.name: Month Key

columns.formula: DatePart("year", Max([Version Pick/Forecast Start Month])) * 12 + DatePart("month", Max([Version Pick/Forecast Start Month]))
columns.name: Start Key

columns.formula: Coalesce([Last Actual], If([Kind] = "flat", [June Base], [June Base] * (1 + [Eff Rate]) ^ ([Base Key] - 24330)))
columns.name: Seed

columns.formula: If([Union of 2 Sources/Section] = "Cost of Revenue", [Union of 2 Sources/Amount], 0)
columns.name: COGS Amt

columns.formula: If([Union of 2 Sources/Section] = "Operating Expenses", [Union of 2 Sources/Amount], 0)
columns.name: OpEx Amt

columns.formula: If(DatePart("year", [PnL Combined/Month End]) * 12 + DatePart("month", [PnL Combined/Month End]) >= Max([Forecast Boundary/Start Key]), "Forecast", IsNull(Lookup(Max([Actuals/Month Key]), DatePart("year", [PnL Combined/Month End]) * 12 + DatePart("month", [PnL Combined/Month End]), [Actuals/Month Key])), "Forecast", "Actual")
columns.name: Phase

columns.formula: If([Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 13 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 24, "FY27", [Forecast Facts/Month Num] >= 1 and [Forecast Facts/Month Num] <= 12, "FY26", Null)
columns.name: Fiscal year
